features.note: No merge regression: top blade hoods forward with a lit top skin, drive blade sweeps opposite showing its broad curved face, bottom blade counter-tilts; adjacent blades never read parallel and the moderate tilt is coherent with the panel's APERTURA 30%. All three blades intact after merging.

No regression: plated stub still protrudes clearly from the frame right face ahead of the black U-clamp; orange body hangs off the shaft, anti-rotation strap drops to a frame foot. In the demo capture the info card now stands fully clear of the clamp and body, so the shaft relationship stays readable while documented.

Round pale-faced dial with bezel and bold dark pointer intact on the actuator head; pointer angle consistent with 30% travel. Arc printing still not resolvable at this frame size — unchanged marginal pass carried from earlier gates, not an optimization regression.

No regression: real ~0.13 m channel depth, flange plates on both faces with discrete fasteners, visible wall thickness at the opening, galv mottle intact. No fastener or flange dropped by the merge pass.

No regression: plated vertical tie rod with crank blocks on the left (non-actuator) side keeps clean edge highlights against the slate background; crank spacing consistent with 30% travel. All crank blocks survived the merges.

important_features.note: Near-black EPDM strips along blade meeting lines read as discrete dark bulbs against the mid-grey blades; jamb seals visible at the sides. The upper-left interior now grades to dark grey instead of crushing flat, so the upper jamb seal separates better than in the interaction gate.

Structured printed plate (header, spec rows, barcode) on the orange body reads as a factory label in the default capture, and — fix landed — the demo capture no longer washes the body to pale orange while the card is open: label contrast holds under hover.

Cable exits the gland, sags in a readable catenary and terminates at the grey junction box on the ground plane. Fix landed: the box now shows beveled edges and top-face detail with a side cable entry, reading as electrical hardware rather than a bare placeholder cube.

defects: Carried marginal (unchanged): the indicator's printed 0-90 arc is still not resolvable at this frame size — the dial passes on pointer/bezel read alone.
Junction box is improved (bevel, top detail, side entry) but remains one notch simpler than the surrounding damper hardware — acceptable, minor.
Residual (much reduced): the deepest upper-left interior corner behind the top blade still dips very dark, though the region now shows visible gradation and the jamb seal separates.
Both captures share one camera viewpoint (two UI states, one angle); per gate contract all scores capped at 0.85.
